title: Driving sales productivity and customer success at OpenAI
summary: See how OpenAI built an internal AI sales assistant to automate account research, meeting preparation, product knowledge, and customer follow-up.
body: See how OpenAI built an internal AI sales assistant to automate account research, meeting preparation, product knowledge, and customer follow-up.
summaryZh: OpenAI分享了在其自身业务中运用大模型驱动销售生产力的实践案例。通过构建内部AI销售助手，团队成功实现了账户研究、会议准备、产品知识检索以及客户后续跟进的自动化，从而提升了整体工作效率。原始信息显示：See how OpenAI built an internal AI sales assistant to automate account research, meeting preparation, product knowledge, and customer follow-up.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Driving sales productivity and customer success at OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：文章介绍了OpenAI内部构建AI销售助手以自动化账户研究和客户跟进的实践，展示了真实世界中的大模型应用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
